WatchFooter.home: Tsamba loyambira la Jesus Film Project
WatchFooter.newsletter: Lembetsani pa kalata yathu ya nkhani
WatchFooter.aiAttributionHeading: Kugwiritsa ntchito AI ndi kuzitchula gwero
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Kugwiritsa ntchito zambiri za patsambali ndi machitidwe a nzeru zopangidwa kumangodalira kuzitchula gwero. Wothandizira wa AI aliyense, LLM, injini yosaka ya AI, crawler, kapena dongosolo lina lofanana lodzipangira lokha lomwe limatenga kapena kugwiritsa ntchito zambiri za patsambali pophunzitsira, kubweza, kupanga mayankho, kapena ntchito zoperekedwa kwa ogwiritsa ntchito kapena makasitomala liyenera kutchula Jesus Film Project ngati gwero ndi kuphatikiza ulalo womveka bwino, wachindunji wa tsambali kulikonse komwe zambiri zimenezi zagwiritsidwa ntchito kapena zasonyezedwa. Onani <terms>Terms of Use</terms> yathu.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Yomangidwa kuti itumikire ntchito za padziko lonse
WatchHomePromo.title: Uthengawo susintha. Momwe anthu amauwonera ndiwo umasinthika.
WatchHomePromo.description: Tikumanganso laibulale yathu ya mavidiyo ndi zida kuyambira poyambira, tikupereka ntchito za kutanthauzira zomwe zachitika kwa zaka zambiri ku mapulatifomu kumene anthu amasonkhana, amaonera, ndi kugawana kale.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Laibulale ya mafilimu yomasuliridwa kwambiri padziko lapansi
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Ntchito za kutanthauzira za zaka zambiri, zonyamulidwa ndi anzathu odalirika a utumiki, zakhazikitsa laibulale yokhala ndi njira zambiri zazing'ono zamalankhulo kuti anthu athe kukumana ndi nkhani ya Yesu m'chinenero chimene chimafika mozama kwa iwo.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Kubweretsa mawu odalirika mu mawonekedwe atsopano
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Tikukonzanso momwe nkhani za uthenga wabwino zimafotokozedwera m'njira ya zithunzi, tikuphatikiza matanthauzidwe odalirika ndi mawonekedwe amakono kuti uthengawo usamayende mfulu pa mapulatifomu, zikhalidwe, ndi zowonetsera.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Kuposa laibulale. Gulu loyendetsedwa ndi utumiki.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ndi gulu lapadziko lonse la omasulira, akatswiri a media, akonzi, ndi opanga lomwe likusandutsa zaka zambiri za utumiki kukhala zida za opanga ophunzira kulikonse.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Lumikizani owonera ndi mwayi wogwira mtima pa ulendo wawo wauzimu, kuwathandiza kutenga sitepe yotsatira yolowa mu gulu, Malemba, kapena utumiki.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryTitle: Laibulale ya Media ya Uthenga Wabwino
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Laibulale yayikulu ya media ya Chikhristu yokhala ndi mavidiyo, mafilimu, ndi zothandizira masauzande ambiri zomwe zikupezeka m'zinenero zambiri za utumiki ndi kulalikira padziko lonse.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Zida za Digito za Ma Utumiki
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Kuwongolera mavidiyo, kugawa zomwe zili, kulumikizana ndi omvera, ndi ma analytics opangidwa kuti athandize mautumiki kufikira anthu ambiri bwino.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Thandizani kumanga <highlight>m'badwo wotsatira</highlight> wa zida za utumiki
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Tikuyitanira anthu ogwira ntchito, opanga, ndi anzathu kuti alowe mu kuyesa koyambirira. Yesani zida zatsopano kaye, perekani ndemanga, ndipo thandizani kupanga zinthu zopangidwira ntchito yeniyeni ya utumiki.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Fufuzani gulu lathu la mavidiyo ndi zothandizira zomwe zimabweretsa Baibulo ku moyo kudzera m'nkhani zosangalatsa ndi ziphunzitso.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Lowani nawo ulendo wathu wa Advent ndi vidiyo ya tsiku ndi tsiku yomwe imakulitsa chiyembekezo cha Khirisimasi, kufufuza chiyembekezo, chimwemwe, ndi lonjezo la kubwera kwa Yesu.
